lead_headline: AI SDK and Workflow SDK lead a dense Thursday, with Astro patching close behind
lead_body: AI SDK shipped two new providers and a clutch of provider fixes across 31 commits and two releases — the window's single busiest project by volume. Workflow SDK worked both ends of the day: replay-stability commits in the early hours, then three production fixes and a v4 wire-format migration by evening. Astro cut two patch releases and cleared a backlog of correctness bugs in MDX, the Node adapter, and redirect handling.
lead_article:
The day's heaviest movement was split between AI SDK and Workflow SDK, with Astro running a close third. AI SDK shipped two new providers — `@ai-sdk/anthropic-aws` and `@ai-sdk/quiverai` — alongside Google search grounding support in `generateImage`, an OpenAI fix that skips passing reasoning items when a previous response ID is present, and a deduplication patch for MCP auth refresh on HTTP transport. A PR landed proposing an agent harness abstraction as a first-class SDK primitive, which is worth watching. Thirty-one commits across two releases made this the busiest SDK day in the window by some margin.

Workflow SDK had its own sustained arc: the day opened with replay-stability work — waiting for a stable workflow turn before replay resumes, yielding replay after buffering hook payloads, and backporting the VM-idle replay counter — then closed with three distinct production fixes: eager subscription of hook iterators, world contract failures promoted to fatal, and per-(run, correlation) uniqueness enforcement for entity-creating events in world-postgres. A `world-vercel` PR switched event endpoints to the v4 wire format. Astro shipped two patch releases (astro@6.3.7 and @astrojs/cloudflare@13.5.4), fixed custom elements in MDX bypassing the renderer pipeline, corrected Buffer and Uint8Array body handling in the Node adapter, and merged a fix for a misleading redirect error. Claude Code cut two releases (v2.1.146 and v2.1.147) while absorbing a notable volume of new issues — file descriptor leak regression, multi-level agent tree orchestration failures, MCP approval deadlocks in scheduled routines, and a macOS background agent TCC churn bug among them. Hydrogen and Metaflow were quiet: one i18n cart fragment fix and a dependency bump, respectively. Gemma.cpp opened a PR for a direct HuggingFace safetensors loader targeting Gemma 4 E2B/E4B variants — small surface area, but a useful reduction in conversion friction if it lands.
